question: Please list the product descriptions of the transactions taken place in the gas stations in the Czech Republic.
actual_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g
  ON g.gas_station_id = t.gas_station_id
JOIN products p
  ON p.product_id = t.product_id
ORDER BY p.description ASC;
expected_response: {"evidence": "Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE'; "}
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.description FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.gas_station_id = T2.gas_station_id INNER JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.product_id = T3.product_id WHERE T2.country = 'CZE'
evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE';

message.content:
The expected_response.evidence specifies that Czech Republic gas stations are identified by `gasstations.country = 'CZE'`. The Prediction Query joins transactions with gasstations and products, but its WHERE/ON conditions contain **no filter on country**, so it lists product descriptions from transactions at all gas stations, not only those in the Czech Republic. This produces extra incorrect results.

```json
{"correct": false}
```
